answer: Each applicant posts a 25 POA bond for twelve epochs and must finish five separate jobs, each audited by three randomly selected reviewers who share no funding source. Two matching approvals pass a job; proven collusion burns 15% of the bond. The ledger stays open, so an anchor of signed history proves tenure, a crystal of inconsistent evidence is rejected, and a raven of duplicated timings exposes scripted swarms. Every extra sybil requires its own bond, job trail, and reviewers, so mass farming costs far more than honest participation.
